references.text: Similar to Jesus' instructions to the disciples not to worry about what they should say when they are interrogated, because the Holy Spirit will speak through them.
Similar to Jesus' assurance to his disciples that the Holy Spirit will teach them what to say when they stand before authorities.
Refers to how Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, spoke to the people.
Refers to how Stephen, full of grace and power, spoke with wisdom that his opponents could not resist.
